register.notes: No state packaging register — RENAP covers only WEEE/batteries/tyres. CONAI (private-law consortium) membership is the compliance mechanism and issues the producer position used in practice.

pro.ecoModulation: CONAI plastic contribution is banded by recyclability, ~€51–922/t (2025, unverified); glass ~€40/t.

notes: Material consortia under CONAI: COREPLA (plastic), COMIECO (paper), RICREA (steel), CIAL (aluminium), COREVE (glass), RILEGNO (wood).
